rules.title: A function that adds only a name
rules.text: A function earns its name by being called more than once, by checking an invariant, or by narrowing a type. A one-expression body with one caller is indirection the reader pays for.

judgement.question: Is this function a wrapper that adds a name but no meaning — one caller, and a body that only forwards to or renames something else?

criteria.true: there is one call site and the body forwards, renames or converts, so the caller could read the same thing directly
criteria.false: it has several callers, or its body is where an invariant is checked, a failure classified, a type narrowed, or a boundary enforced
